description: This file declares the IMediaKeysIpcFactory interface, a factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances for IPC in the Rialto media client. It includes method declarations for creating media keys based on a key system string and a static method to create the factory itself.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create IMediaKeys instances for IPC, and a static method to instantiate the factory itself.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method that creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaKeys object for a given key system.
